lesson.ice_cream_shop.title: Ice Cream Shop
lesson.ice_cream_shop.summary: Build a playful ice-cream stand from simple shapes, then invent toppings, patterns and sign details that make the shop yours.
lesson.ice_cream_shop.step.cone_or_cup: Start with a simple cone base. Join two sloping sides under a roomy top edge.
lesson.ice_cream_shop.help.cone_or_cup_h: Keep the cone wide enough for the scoops that will sit above it.
lesson.ice_cream_shop.complete.cone_or_c: Your ice cream has a sturdy base.
lesson.ice_cream_shop.step.scoops: Stack three broad scoop curves. Let each scoop overlap the one below just enough to feel connected.
lesson.ice_cream_shop.help.scoops_hint: Build from the biggest lower scoop upward, leaving each curve roomy and easy to see.
lesson.ice_cream_shop.complete.scoops: Three scoops are stacked and ready for your design.
lesson.ice_cream_shop.step.shop_sign: Add a simple shop sign beside the ice cream: one panel and a support.
lesson.ice_cream_shop.help.shop_sign_hin: Place the sign where it has breathing room and does not cover the ice cream.
lesson.ice_cream_shop.complete.shop_sign: Your drawing now feels like a tiny shop.
lesson.ice_cream_shop.step.make_it_yours: Sprinkles, a cherry, a wafer and sign marks are only ideas. Pick what fits your shop—or invent your own topping and sign.
lesson.ice_cream_shop.help.make_it_yours: Try repeating a small mark to make a pattern, or give your sign one simple symbol.
lesson.ice_cream_shop.complete.drawing: Your ice cream shop now has a design that belongs to you.
